name: headershim
description: Modify HTTP request and response headers with scoped rules and switchable profiles.

scripts.check:platform: paths='src/core'; if [ -d src/ui ]; then paths="$paths src/ui"; fi; if grep -R -n -E 'browser[.]|chrome[.]' $paths; then echo 'Extension API references must stay in platform adapters or entrypoints.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.check: biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && vitest run --coverage && knip && knip --production --include files && pnpm check:fake-browser && jscpd && pnpm build && node scripts/manifest-policy.mjs && size-limit && pnpm check:platform && pnpm check:icons && pnpm check:overrides && pnpm check:self-contained && pnpm check:em-dash
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm build:e2e:hostaccess && playwright test

//overrides: adm-zip: firefox-profile 4.7.0 restricts adm-zip to ~0.5.x, which triggers GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85. Drop when firefox-profile accepts adm-zip 0.6.0 or later, or when WXT no longer reaches firefox-profile through web-ext-run.

multimatch: web-ext-run 0.2.4 pins multimatch to 6.0.0, which reaches brace-expansion 1 and GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg. Drop when web-ext-run accepts multimatch 8.0.0 or later, or when WXT no longer depends on web-ext-run.

shell-quote: fx-runner 1.4.0 pins shell-quote to 1.7.3, which triggers GHSA-395f-4hp3-45gv and GHSA-w7jw-789q-3m8p. Drop when fx-runner accepts shell-quote 1.9.0 or later, or when WXT no longer reaches fx-runner through web-ext-run.
tmp: web-ext-run 0.2.4 pins tmp to 0.2.5, which triggers GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65. Drop when web-ext-run accepts tmp 0.2.6 or later, or when WXT no longer depends on web-ext-run.

uuid: node-notifier 10.0.1 restricts uuid to ^8.3.2, which triggers GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq. Drop when node-notifier excludes the affected uuid ranges, or when WXT no longer reaches node-notifier through web-ext-run.
